name: Spanjaard Limited
summary: Spanjaard Limited manufactures and distributes specialized lubricants and allied chemical products worldwide. It operates through Automotive, Industrial, Exports, and Consumer Goods segments. The company produces a range of food aerosol products; trades in anti-friction powders; and sells fuel additives, greases, and car care products. It serves the consumer goods, automotive, industrial, marine and mining, and household markets. Spanjaard Limited was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Sandton, South Africa. Spanjaard Limited is a subsidiary of Spanjaard Group Limited.
